scope: Bounded read-only source/dataflow audit of existing frame/time/weather path, not a complete time-service inventory, code move or Task51/D3 acceptance.

facts.fact: Public Lua engine:frame accepts milliseconds:u32 and forwards caller time to Engine.frame.
Engine.frame passes milliseconds unchanged to native eech_engine_frame with installed callbacks.
Native frame runs entity/update/timer work first, then advances headless milliseconds and calls set_delta_time. Original previous-frame delta phase is deliberately preserved.
A uint32 simulated_ms mirror is read, advanced by caller milliseconds and set from configuration; these operations sample no wall clock.
timeGetTime delegates to the simulated millisecond mirror.
Reset delta begins at0.1. set_delta_time computes the float millisecond difference/1000 with original zero-delta and locked-rate behavior. No timing semantics changed.
Physical weather request.delta reads get_delta_time at its original point before clock advance, then host field solver consumes that delta.
Campaign elapsed/time-of-day acceleration, skip-night/day-segment and resync/scheduling semantics remain campaign-owned; do not move them merely because they concern time.
